findings.title: Suppress source lines in unraisable exceptions from the source-free diagnostic helper
findings.classification: product/infrastructure defect; normal intake must assign risk route and scoped ownership
findings.confidence: confirmed for Python3.13.12/Linux project interpreter and separate Python3.12.14/Linux; other platforms/channels untested
findings.observed: Through public scripts/source_free_check.py, a synthetic __del__ raising RuntimeError prints its complete source line and unique source-only comment to stderr while returning ordinary Python status0. The installed source-free hooks omit sys.unraisablehook. Direct unclosed-file ResourceWarning remains source-free in the positive control.
findings.expected: The blind diagnostic channel should omit source snippets while retaining exception category, useful message, filename/line and appropriate ordinary process status. AGENTS and role-launch guidance require source-free relevant diagnostics before blind probes; the public helper advertises source-free Python/pytest diagnostics.
completion: Assign a normal intake contract and named diagnostic-helper/test ownership; preserve prior source-free channels and Python process/diagnostic meaning.

Independently reproduce the current synthetic unraisable marker leak, then verify source-marker absence with retained RuntimeError/message/location and ordinary status. Keep a legitimate direct ResourceWarning control.
Record supported interpreter/platform/channel scope and missing evidence; obtain the route-required independent review and exact candidate checks before submission.
findings.existing_work_reconciliation: The supplied existing-issues.json open/closed snapshot has no matching diagnostic helper issue. No remote mutation or independent remote freshness/deduplication claim is made; coordinator must recheck before publication.
findings.uncertainty: Failure channel is confirmed; implementation repair is not commissioned by this cohort report. No product source was exposed in the probes. Exact desired support for other unraisable contexts and pytest capture belongs to intake; no current full gate or macOS probe was run.

limitations: Every assigned lesson was read in full; current-code checks were narrowly selected for each mechanism, not a full product or test audit.
Only the authorized synthetic diagnostic probes were executed. No product test suite, make verify, doctor CLI, native Codex launch, viewer or remote mutation was run.

Historical ignored role reports/receipts referenced by many tasks are not present as a complete accepted-candidate bundle in this checkout. Static current guards and test definitions do not certify the exact historical final acceptance.

Old scientific APIs/tests are explicitly retired. Historical scientific failures and corrected observers were not mapped automatically onto replacement CE semantics; no current equivalent defect is inferred solely from topic similarity.

Resolved handling is confined to the two named historical public failures with checked current code plus explicit retained verification/review records. It does not resolve all general prevention advice from those lessons.
Existing issue reconciliation uses the coordinator-provided snapshot; remote freshness and prepublication duplicate recheck remain coordinator work.
The unraisable probe covers Linux CPython3.13.12 and3.12.14 only. The separate ResourceWarning control passes; macOS/pytest unraisable capture/other hooks are untested.
